e: Correct answer: Expense (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Share Forfeiture A/c .....Dr. - 300

To, Capital reserve A/c .....Cr. - 300"

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are not true about the accounting policies to be followed buy General Insurance companies as per the AS-11?

I. The assets and liabilities, both monetary and non-monetary of the non-integral foreign operations are translated at the closing rate
II. Other assets and liabilities in foreign currencies are converted at the buying rate of exchange prevailing at the year end
III. Depreciation on fixed assets held in foreign branches and agencies is provided on Cost of acquisition.
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Shobha has bought a life insurance policy from LIC. This policy has been reinsured by the insurance company with reinsurer ABC Reinsurance Corp. In the given scenario which of the following is true?
o: In the case of a claim, Shobha will have a separat
In the case of a claim, insurance company LIC will pay the entire claim to Shobha, irrespective of whether reinsurer ABC Reinsurance Corp. pays or doesn't pay its share of the claim to LIC
In the case of claim shobha shall not receive any
In the case of a claim, reinsurer ABC Reinsurance
e: Correct answer: In the case of a claim, insurance company LIC will pay the entire claim to Shobha, irrespective of whether reinsurer ABC Reinsurance Corp. pays or doesn't pay its share of the claim to LIC (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A company possesses a legal entity separate from its shareholders, members and management. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: The company does not have a separate legal entity
The creditors of the company can sue the sharehold
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Depreciation on assets purchased upto 30 September should be provided at _______.
o: No depreciation needs to be provided
The rates suggested by management of company
Should be provided on a proportionate basis
e: Correct answer: Applicable rates (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Discount on issue of debentures is a ___________.
o: Revenue loss to be charged in the year of issue
Capital loss to be written off from the capital re
Capital loss to be written off over the tenure of debenture
Capital loss to be shown as goodwill
Capital gain to be shown as goodwill
e: Correct answer: Capital loss to be written off over the tenure of debenture (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A general insurance company has impairment in value of its investments in the form of mutual funds. How should they be treated?

I. The impairment value is charged to revenue and the book value of investment is reduced accordingly
II. The impairment value is charged to expense account
III. The whole value of the mutual fund is charged to revenue account
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A firm purchases a computer and makes payment by cheque for Rs. 40,000. Which entry will be passed?
o: DR Bank Account CR Computer Account
DR Computer Account CR Bank Account
DR Computer Account CR Cash Account
DR Cash Account CR Computer Account
DR Computer Account CR Creditor Account
e: Correct answer: DR Computer Account CR Bank Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The major considerations in selecting an accounting policy are:
o: Accrual, substance over form and materiality
Prudence, substance over form and materiality
Prudence, substance over form and relevance
e: Correct answer: Prudence, substance over form and materiality (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Priyanka is a cotton  trader. Which of the following is not a current asset for her?
e: Correct answer: Building (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Entire premium received on sum insured
A margin percentage in the ceding company's profit
A fixed yearly amount based on their treaty

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI (General Insurance - Reinsurance) Regulations, 2000, not more than _______ of reinsurance premium is to be placed with one re-insurer.
e: Correct answer: 10% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
